body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: How to Steelman an Argument
paras: **Step 1.** Read the opposing view **in full** before you respond. **Step 2.** Restate it in your own words **so that its author would say**, “Yes, that is what I mean.” **Step 3.** Identify its **strongest premises**, **even if** you think the conclusion false.

**Step 4.** Repair weak points **in order to** give the argument its best chance; do not **set up a straw man**. **Step 5.** Only then, **raise your objection**. Should it **still stand**, you will have earned it.

items.q: You should object before restating the view.
A straw man is a distorted version of the view.
items.why: The text only says not to set one up.

items.q: You should repair weak points in the opposing argument.

rows: Repair weak points **in order to** give it a chance

blocks.body: Em instruções filosóficas, o **imperativo** abre cada passo e **in order to / so that** explicam o porquê. O ritmo é lento e a ênfase cai em *full*, *own words*, *only then*.
*So that* pede oração com sujeito; *in order to* pede verbo no infinitivo: *in order to understand* ✓, *in order that understand* ✗.

items.s: Repair weak points ___ order to help it. (in)
Restate it ___ that its author would agree. (so)
Do ___ set up a straw man. (not)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Give credit where it’s due.** — Dar crédito a quem merece.
**Play fair.** — Jogar limpo.
**Meet halfway.** — Chegar a um meio-termo.
**Hear someone out.** — Ouvir alguém até o fim.
**Level the playing field.** — Nivelar o jogo.
**Take a step back.** — Dar um passo atrás.
**Put oneself in someone’s shoes.** — Pôr-se no lugar de alguém.
**Go back to basics.** — Voltar ao básico.
**Pull apart.** — Desmontar.
**Hold one’s ground.** — Manter a posição.
**How do I begin?** — Como eu começo?
**Read the opposing view in full first.** — Leia a visão oposta por inteiro primeiro.
**And then object?** — E então objeto?

blocks.task: Write a 5-step set of instructions for preparing a fair seminar discussion.
blocks.model: Step 1. Read the text in full. Step 2. Note its main claim in order to keep the focus. Step 3. List one strong objection. Step 4. Prepare a reply so that you can answer fairly. Step 5. Listen carefully before speaking.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
